import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
API="https://api.genome.ucsc.edu/getData/track"
def vals(tr,s,e):
    js=requests.get(API,params=dict(genome="hg38",track=tr,chrom="chr10",start=s,end=e),timeout=120).json()
    d=js[tr]; items=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get("chr10",[])
    a=np.full(e-s,np.nan)
    for it in items:
        for p in range(max(it["start"],s),min(it["end"],e)): a[p-s]=it["value"]
    return a
regions={"isoform 2\nmicro-exon":(84222827,84222857),
         "constitutive\nexon 2 end":(84224333,84224393),
         "constitutive\nexon 3 start":(84222620,84222680),
         "intron\ncontrol":(84223200,84223500)}
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13.5,7.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.15],hspace=0.45,wspace=0.28)

# panel A: isoform schematic
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
doms=[("signal\npeptide",1,19,"#999999"),("LRRNT",23,54,"#7fb3d5"),("LRR1",80,103,"#2e86c1"),("LRR2",104,125,"#2e86c1"),
      ("LRR3",128,149,"#2e86c1"),("LRR4",152,173,"#2e86c1"),("LRRCT",200,252,"#7fb3d5"),
      ("Ig-like",253,341,"#f39c12"),("FN3",361,451,"#27ae60"),("TM",466,486,"#8e44ad"),("disordered",508,550,"#d5d8dc")]
for y,(lab,shift,tot) in enumerate([("A6NDA9-1 (550 aa, MANE, retina cDNA)",0,550),("A6NDA9-2 (560 aa, pooled-tissue cDNA)",10,560)]):
    yy=1-y*0.55
    ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((1,yy-0.08),tot,0.16,fc="white",ec="black",lw=.8))
    for nm,a,b,c in doms:
        a2=a+(shift if a>297 else 0); b2=b+(shift if b>297 else 0)
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((a2,yy-0.13),b2-a2,0.26,fc=c,ec="black",lw=.5))
        if y==0: ax.text((a2+b2)/2,yy+0.20,nm,ha="center",fontsize=7.2)
    if y==1:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((298,yy-0.19),10,0.38,fc="crimson",ec="black",lw=.8))
        ax.annotate("+GLLGGKHLTP\n(10 aa, inside Ig beta strand 294-302)",xy=(303,yy-0.21),xytext=(330,yy-0.52),
                    color="crimson",fontsize=8.5,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="crimson"))
    ax.text(-8,yy,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_xlim(-180,600); ax.set_ylim(-0.1,1.45); ax.axis("off")
ax.set_title("Both LRIT2 isoforms carry the identical domain set; isoform 2 adds 10 residues inside the Ig-like domain",fontsize=11)

# panel B/C: conservation
for k,(tr,lab) in enumerate([("phyloP100way","phyloP (100 vertebrates)"),("phastCons100way","phastCons (100 vertebrates)")]):
    ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,k])
    dat=[]; 
    for nm,(s,e) in regions.items():
        a=vals(tr,s,e); dat.append(a[~np.isnan(a)])
    bp=ax.boxplot(dat,labels=list(regions),patch_artist=True,showfliers=False)
    for p,c in zip(bp["boxes"],["crimson","steelblue","steelblue","#cccccc"]): p.set_facecolor(c); p.set_alpha(.75)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    for i,d in enumerate(dat,1): ax.scatter(rng.normal(i,0.06,len(d)),d,s=6,color="black",alpha=.35,zorder=3)
    ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=.7,ls="--")
    u=stats.mannwhitneyu(dat[0],dat[3],alternative="greater")
    v=stats.mannwhitneyu(dat[0],dat[1],alternative="less")
    ax.set_ylabel(lab,fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title(f"micro-exon vs intron p={u.pvalue:.2f} (not more conserved)\nmicro-exon vs constitutive exon p={v.pvalue:.1e} (less conserved)",fontsize=8.5)
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
plt.suptitle("LRIT2 isoform 2: the 30-nt cassette exon shows no vertebrate sequence constraint",fontsize=12,y=0.995)
plt.show()
